# TruckWala 24×7

TruckWala 24×7 is a commercial vehicle service and truck breakdown assistance website for the Kanpur–Unnao transport corridor in Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Primary services
- 24×7 commercial truck breakdown assistance
- Roadside mechanical repair
- Heavy commercial vehicle repair
- ECM / computer diagnostics
- Commercial vehicle electrical and mechanical troubleshooting
- Spare-parts support
- Fleet service support

## Vehicle coverage
The site describes support for Tata Motors Commercial, Ashok Leyland, Eicher Trucks & Buses, BharatBenz, Mahindra and other commercial vehicles.

## Common breakdown topics
- Engine starting and battery faults
- Air leaks and brake problems
- AdBlue / DEF and BS6 derate faults
- Engine overheating and coolant loss
- Starter and electrical faults
- Turbocharger / boost problems
- Fuel injection and pump issues
- Clutch, gearbox, suspension and axle issues

## Service area
Kanpur–Unnao NH-27 transport corridor, including the Gadan Khera Bypass / Unnao area described on the website.

## Official website
https://truckwala24x7.com/
